archReview.notes: arch-scan: archSpecific=true (rvv-intrinsic, riscv-macro). Target SpacemiT X100/K3, RVV 1.0, VLEN=256, vlenb=32 (metadata Tag_RISCV_arch contains v1p0/zve*/zvl128b; diaglog Phase 1 vlenb=32). vsetvl/vtype self-consistent (dynamic __riscv_vsetvl_e32m4 + all _e32m4 intrinsics, SEW=e32, LMUL=m4); mask type vbool8_t correct for e32/m4 (32/4=8); scalar<->vector boundary (interior vector, prefix/suffix/row-border scalar) with vlse32 byte stride stride_w*4; compile-time __riscv_v gate and float-non-template vs generic-template overload dispatch self-consistent; no x86/ARM instructions. Register spill cannot be verified from provided artifacts (no disassembly) -> downgraded to suggestion S2.

hallucinationCheck.dimension: 架构结论基于提供证据

findings.evidence: patch.diff hunk: "+        const size_t vl = __riscv_vsetvl_e32m4(static_cast<size_t>(n - i));" and "+        vfloat32m4_t vmax = __riscv_vfmv_v_f_f32m4(-FLT_MAX, vl);"; blueprint.diagnosis.recommendedFirstAction field records AlexNet pooled_width 为 27/13/6.
findings.suggestion: e32m4 在 VLEN=256 下为 32 lane，而 AlexNet interior 向量长度 n 通常仅 27/13/6，短向量下 m4 的大寄存器组利用率低且可能抬高 vsetvl/寄存器压力。建议在目标核 A/B 上评估 e32m1 或 e32m2 的吞吐/占用，再决定最终 LMUL（当前实现语义正确，不阻断通过）。

findings.evidence: patch.diff hunk: "+            const vbool8_t gt = __riscv_vmfgt_vv_f32m4_b8(tap, vmax, vl);" 与同段同时 live 的 "+        vint32m4_t vindex = __riscv_vmv_v_x_i32m4(-1, vl);"、"+        const vuint32m4_t lane = __riscv_vid_v_u32m4(vl);"、"+            const vfloat32m4_t tap = __riscv_vlse32_v_f32m4("、"+            const vint32m4_t cand ="、"+        __riscv_vmerge_vvm_f32m4(vmax, tap, gt, vl);"。
findings.suggestion: 该段同时持有 vmax/vindex/tap/lane/lane_off/cand 及 vbool8 掩码，e32m4 下约 5 个四寄存器组。当前 artifact 无编译产物或反汇编，无法核实是否发生 vector spill（cannot verify）。建议对目标构建做 objdump/llvm-objdump 反汇编确认无 vspill/reload，再据实更新说明。
